description: This file contains a PHP trait 'HTMLUtils' that provides utility methods for directory management and copying theme files, used within the HTML formatting context of the project.

methods.name: ensureEmptyDestination
methods.description: Ensures that the specified destination directory is empty by removing it if it exists or creating it if it does not.

methods.name: copyThemes
methods.description: Copies theme files from a local base directory to a specified destination directory, creating a 'themes' subdirectory.
